manifesto.heading: Manifesto • Architecture & Vision
manifesto.card1Text: 0xTsoa is the open reference registry dedicated to discovering, documenting, and deploying minimal, lightweight, and reproducible Linux desktop environments.
manifesto.card2Text: Ready-to-use full environments (Hyprland, Sway, stripped GNOME, i3/bspwm), battle-tested dotfiles, and advanced battery autonomy profiles.
manifesto.card3Text:
1. Explore real developer workstations.
2. Inspect specs and hardware benchmarks.
3. Deploy the desktop via shell script or clone the dotfiles directly.

spec.securityNotice: Security: Always inspect external scripts before local execution. Command pinned to an immutable SHA-256 digest.

contribute.title: CONTRIBUTE TO 0xTsoa
contribute.subtitle: A decentralized registry without logins: everything runs through GitHub.
contribute.method1Desc: Create your config file configs/<your-user>/<your-slug>.json and open a PR. Our CI automatically validates schemas and URLs.
contribute.method2Desc: Prefer not dealing with JSON directly? Fill our issue template. A GitHub Action will convert it into a PR for you.
